hubs.label: Car Games
hubs.title: Free Car Games Online - Racing, Parking & Stunts
hubs.description: Play free car games online, from racing and parking to drifting, stunt and traffic challenges, with clear controls and direct game profiles.
hubs.introduction: Choose a car game built around racing, parking, drifting, stunts or traffic. This collection uses verified catalogue signals to keep vehicle-led games together without treating every racing title as a car game.
hubs.selectionNote: A game qualifies when its source category identifies cars, or when a car-led title and vehicle metadata agree. Motorcycle-only, generic racing and unrelated substring matches are excluded.

hubs.label: 2 Player Games
hubs.title: 2 Player Games Online - Play Together
hubs.description: Browse 2 player games for shared-keyboard, same-device and head-to-head play, with profile details to help you check controls before starting.
hubs.introduction: Find games that explicitly identify two-player play rather than a vague multiplayer theme. Check each profile and the loaded game's instructions to see whether the match uses one keyboard, one device or another supported setup.
hubs.selectionNote: Two-player source metadata or an explicit two-player statement is required. Generic multiplayer wording alone never qualifies a game.

hubs.label: .io Games
hubs.title: .io Games Online - Arena & Multiplayer Play
hubs.description: Play .io games online across arena, survival, racing and action styles, using a collection that avoids matching unrelated words containing io.
hubs.introduction: Browse games explicitly identified as .io titles or carrying a recognised .io game name. The collection includes arena, survival and competitive formats without assuming that every multiplayer game belongs here.
hubs.selectionNote: A recognised .io source category or a title ending in .io is required. The letters 'io' inside an unrelated title, slug or description never count.

hubs.label: Dress Up Games
hubs.title: Free Dress Up Games Online - Fashion & Makeovers
hubs.description: Play free dress up games online for outfits, fashion, makeovers and character styling, selected from explicit catalogue evidence.
hubs.introduction: Explore outfit, fashion, makeover and character-styling games that make dress-up play the central activity. Games qualify from explicit source categories or corroborated titles and tags, not from a stray clothing reference.
hubs.selectionNote: Dress-up source metadata is accepted directly. Other records need both a relevant title or description and a matching dress-up catalogue tag.

hubs.label: Shooting Games
hubs.title: Free Shooting Games Online - Aim, Action & Survival
hubs.description: Play free shooting games online across target, sniper, survival and action formats, with controls and device guidance on every game profile.
hubs.introduction: Choose from shooting games where aiming, firing or target selection drives the challenge. The collection covers direct action, survival and precision formats while excluding games that merely mention a weapon in passing.
hubs.selectionNote: Explicit shooting, shooter or first-person-shooter source categories qualify. Other records need action context plus corroborating shooting or sniper metadata.

hubs.label: Word Games
hubs.title: Free Word Games Online - Search, Spell & Solve
hubs.description: Play free word games online, including word search, spelling, crossword, anagram and vocabulary puzzles with clear browser play routes.
hubs.introduction: Browse games where finding, building or solving words is the main task. This collection brings together word searches, spelling, crosswords and anagrams without treating every puzzle description containing the word 'word' as a match.
hubs.selectionNote: A word-game source category qualifies directly. Other records need a word-led title or description together with an explicit word-game tag.
